Metadata.title: Fi Sikkati — Find people already going your way
Metadata.description: Community ride-sharing for El Obour City and nearby areas. Drivers publish the trips they already plan to make; passengers find one going their way and request a seat.

Landing.headline: Find people already going your way.
Landing.subheadline: Not a taxi, not a car on demand. Neighbours heading the same way publish their trips, and you find the one that fits your route and your timing, then ask for a seat.
Landing.statusNote: The platform is still being built — accounts and trips open with the first release.

difference.title: Why this is not a taxi app
difference.body: Nobody orders a car here. The trip already exists — we give you a safe, structured way to join it.

notTaxi.title: The trip exists first
notTaxi.body: The driver is going anyway. You share an empty seat instead of summoning a car.

routeMatch.title: Matched by route
routeMatch.body: We compare your way with the trip's route and timing, so you only see drivers actually heading your direction.

neighbours.title: People from your area
neighbours.body: Verified accounts from the El Obour community, with mutual ratings after every trip.

Landing.howItWorksBody: From publishing a trip to rating it, every step happens inside the app.

publish.title: A driver publishes a trip
publish.body: Origin, destination, departure time and the number of free seats.

discover.title: Passengers find it
discover.body: Search by where you are, where you're going and when; results rank by how close the route is.

join.title: Request, accept, ride
join.body: Ask for a seat, the driver accepts, you talk inside the trip, then rate each other.

Landing.trustTitle: Built for a community, not a marketplace
Landing.trustBody: Trust isn't a slogan here — it's deliberate steps before, during and after every trip.

verified.title: Verified identities
verified.body: Drivers and riders are checked before their first trip, and the badge shows on the profile.

pickup.title: Approximate pickup points
pickup.body: Your exact location stays hidden until your request is accepted.

chat.title: Chat inside the trip
chat.body: Every detail lives in one place tied to the trip, not lost in a group thread.

report.title: Reporting and blocking
report.body: Bad behaviour can be reported, reviewed by moderators and acted on.

closing.title: Let's make the El Obour commute easier
closing.body: We are building the platform step by step. The first release opens registration, trip publishing and search.
closing.note: Registration opens with the first release.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.body: We could not complete that action. Please try again.

Footer.blurb: Community ride-sharing between residents of El Obour and nearby areas — structure for what used to live in WhatsApp groups.
